_doc: Per-park inputs for park_fence.py. center: lat,lon the 7x7 z19 tile mosaic is centred on (pixel coords below refer to that mosaic). home: approximate home plate px and CF bearing (image degrees, 0=east, 90=south) to start the foul-line search; search: optional [deg, m] window; mound: use home = mound - 18.0 m instead of the foul lines. method: poly (robust polynomial of `deg`, `exclude` angles left out), polygon (straight walls between RDP corners, `tol` m), square (side walls square to the foul lines at the pole distance + flat CF wall, from anchors). anchors: official/press distances at angles (null = keep measured).

문학.note: no official source found; community table 95/115/120 has the gaps wrong (113).

수원.note: -2..+9 deg left out of the fit: the trace takes the batter's-eye edge behind the wall.

사직.note: 2022 figures (home plate moved 2.884 m back); the 2024 change only lowered the wall. CF wall in stand shadow.

창원.note: traced side walls straight (<=0.16 m mean residual), 90.6 deg apart and 100.5/101.3 m from home: walls square to the foul lines + flat CF wall. Trace within 1.2 m (mean 0.4) except a 2 m notch at +1..+5 deg; CF corners 123.8 at 9.7 deg (wiki: 중앙 좌·우측 123).

대전.note: club figures (프로스포츠협회 웹진). The foul-line search locks onto other lines here, so home = mound - 18 m.

광주.note: CF 121 (press); poles left as measured since the press gives 98 or 99. Esri trace agrees within 1 m (1.9 m at the RF bullpen).

대구.note: walls square to the foul lines + flat CF wall: traced side walls straight (0.1 m mean residual) and 90 deg apart; Bing and VWorld traces within 1.4 m. Matches press 좌우중간 107 (107.7 at 22.5 deg) and 좌중·우중 123.4 (corners 123.85 at 8.46 deg).
